split.release_rule: first read after 3 days of the PR 960 cadence have landed (about 2026-11-19), then on each auto-run; kill_fast on the first read

declined_list_rows_checked: favourite-and-hold (the Head asked for the favourite at a fixed game-clock point; that side is on the declined list, so the UNDERDOG is bought; flagged to the Head)
uniqueness.difference: the NHL moneyline underdog at a fixed point in the game, priced 15c to 35c; comebacks underpriced by fans of the leader

data.loader: ingame_load.py (forward version, needs_new_code: window from 2026-11-17T00:00Z, results from a forward kalshi-pull listing, a new allow line)
data.loader_sha256: pending (the forward version is written, audited and listed before the first auto-run)
extracts: sports-data ingame/<date>/<HHMM>/obs.csv.gz for date directories from 2026-11-17
a forward settled-markets listing of the ticker wall, closes from 2026-11-17T00:00Z (job to be written)
data.held_out_map_checked_by: pending Auditor B (forward window; SPORTS-PRE holds KXNBAGAME and KXNFLGAME outcomes to 2027-01-01, so those two are outside every wall here)
data.independence_note: the same games feed all History Miner in-game specs; their rows are one sample of games, n not to be added across specs

event.decision_instant: tip + 75 min (tip = the listing's occurrence_datetime minus 3 h (schedule-shaped proxy, truth unproven; the PREDRIFT1 schedule test applies, NFL weaker)); quote = the last two-sided poll within the 5 minutes before
event.entry_rule: of the game's two team tickers, buy YES on the one whose ask is 0.15 to 0.35 (the underdog); if both or neither, no trade; one per game

prediction: 2c PF >= 1.3 with each half >= 1.0 at n >= 100 (NHL only: n 100 needs about 7 weeks)
kill: 2c PF under 1.0 on the first read (kill_fast), or under 100 games by 2026-12-15

outputs.survivor_line: market, rule, PF 1c and 2c, n, days
